scenario: A triple-quoted, two-line, indented `log` message compiles. LGRA.2.10.4 trims it cleandoc-style: common leading whitespace and leading and trailing blank lines go. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` reads neither the trimmed text nor the lowered output.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log info """
        line one
        line two
        """
